actus.title: finally, normal service is resumed
actus.excerpt: Four out of the six class winners are now known: following Tom Laperche (Ultim), Basile Bourgnon (Ocean Fifty), and Corentin Horeau (IMOCA), local hero Damien Seguin secured the title in his Rhum Multi class last night. Now only the Class40 and Rhum Mono classes have yet to be decided.

actus.title: 🌦️ WEATHER CONSULT BULLETIN OF NOVEMBER 12
actus.excerpt: Ce jeudi 12 novembre, onze jours après le départ de la Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe 2026, Alexia Barrier et Anne-Claire Le Berre marquent l’histoire en devenant les premières femmes à boucler une transatlantique en solitaire, respectivement en Ultim et en Ocean Fifty.

actus.title: Boris herrmann second in imoca on the route du rhum destination guadeloupe
actus.excerpt: Finishing in early morning rain German skipper Boris Herrmann added to his growing list of solo Transatlantic successes today when he took second  place in the IMOCA class on the 13th edition of the Route du Rhum Destination, the solo ocean sprint from Saint Malo to Gudeloupe.

actus.title: Anne-Claire Le Berre (Upwind By Merconcept), seventh in the Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe in the Ocean Fifty class
actus.excerpt: She is the first woman to participate in and complete a solo transatlantic race in the Ocean Fifty class! With a diverse background, Anne-Claire Le Berre has fulfilled a dream by skippering the trimaran for which she was selected by MerConcept to take on the role of a pioneer.

actus.title: Alexia Barrier : “I am hungry to return and do more”
actus.excerpt: Twenty minutes before reaching the finish line she shed tears of joy. Once she crossed it, Alexia Barrier celebrated on the bow of her boat as she ebcame the first woman to complete a transatlantic crossing solo in the  Ultim class on the Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe.
